seo.title: Kibay Sparkling | Sustainable Sparkling Wine from Dominican Republic
seo.description: Kibay Sparkling: A premium sustainable sparkling wine crafted with mango and passion fruit. Fermented, not flavored. Real wine, refreshingly alive.

hero.subtitle: Sustainable Sparkling Wine with Mango & Passion Fruit
hero.body: Fermented, not flavored. Real wine, refreshingly alive. A sophisticated expression of Dominican terroir crafted for modern enjoyment.

what.heading: A Real Sparkling Wine
what.body: Kibay Sparkling is true wine, achieved through natural fermentation. We don't simply mix fruit juice with alcohol. We ferment premium, sustainable mango and passion fruit from Ocoa Bay to create a complex, structured sparkling wine that retains the authentic soul of its ingredients.
notItems: Not a wine cooler or spritzer

origin.heading: From the Dominican Republic
origin.body1: Born in the unique microclimate of Ocoa Bay, where the mountains meet the Caribbean Sea. This dry, sunny region produces mangoes and chinola (passion fruit) with concentrated flavors and exceptional aromatics essential for high-quality winemaking.
origin.body2: Our production happens entirely on the island, supporting local agriculture and minimizing our carbon footprint.
origin.quote: "From the same winery as Kibay wine — by Ocoa Bay"
origin.imgSubtitle: The first vineyard in the Caribbean

flavor.heading: Taste the Terroir
flavor.intro: A sophisticated profile that balances the natural sweetness of tropical fruit with the crisp acidity of a well-crafted sparkling wine.
flavor.aromaBody: Elegant and expressive, opening with distinct notes of ripe mango and hints of tropical florals, underpinned by a fresh citrus zest.
flavor.palateBody: Refreshing and balanced. The passion fruit brings a lively acidity that dances on the tongue, perfectly countered by a round, fruity body that is never cloying.
flavor.finishBody: Clean, crisp, and persistent. Leaves a pleasant tropical memory that invites another sip without coating the palate in sugar.

philosophy.heading: Crafted with Intention
philosophy.body1: We believe that the best flavors come from nature, not a lab. That's why Kibay Sparkling is made without artificial sugars, chemical flavorings, or synthetic additives.
philosophy.body2: Our philosophy is simple: respect the ingredients. By using sustainable fermentation methods, we preserve the integrity of the fruit and the land it comes from. It's a cleaner, more authentic way to enjoy sparkling wine.
philosophy.imgAlt: Fresh mango and passion fruit close-up product photography showing key ingredients in Kibay Sparkling

enjoy.heading: Ready for Any Moment
enjoy.intro: Versatile enough for a glass, casual enough for the can.

items.title: Chilled in Glass
items.desc: Pour into a flute to appreciate the fine bubbles and golden color.

items.title: Straight from the Can
items.desc: Enjoy the premium experience anywhere, no glassware required.

items.title: Beachside
items.desc: The perfect sunset companion. Refreshing, tropical, and unbreakable.

items.title: Dinner Pairing
items.desc: Acidity cuts through rich foods; pairs beautifully with seafood or spice.

closing.heading: Wine Without Ceremony
closing.body: We've stripped away the pretension to reveal what matters: exceptional craftsmanship, authentic origin, and the pure joy of the Caribbean. This is modern wine culture.
